Classic Holiday Hot Cocoa

Served at: St. Nicholas Day · Sinterklaas Arrival (Intocht) · Christmas Eve

Serves 4Prep 5 minCook 10 min

Hot cocoa is a beloved, warming beverage perfect for chilly holiday evenings. It's especially cherished during St. Nicholas Day, Sinterklaas Arrival celebrations, and Christmas Eve, offering a sweet, comforting treat for children and adults alike as they await gifts or gather with loved ones. Its rich, chocolatey flavor and creamy texture make it a festive staple.

Ingredients

  • 4 cups (960 ml) whole milk
  • 1/2 cup (60 g) unsweetened cocoa powder
  • 1/2 cup (100 g) granulated sugar
  • 1/4 teaspoon fine sea salt
  • 1 teaspoon (5 ml) pure vanilla extract
  • Optional toppings: whipped cream, marshmallows, chocolate shavings

Method

  1. In a medium saucepan, combine the unsweetened cocoa powder, granulated sugar, and fine sea salt.
  2. Whisk in about 1/2 cup (120 ml) of the milk until a smooth, thick paste forms, ensuring there are no lumps.
  3. Gradually whisk in the remaining 3 1/2 cups (840 ml) of milk until fully incorporated.
  4. Place the saucepan over medium heat, whisking frequently, until the mixture is hot and steaming but not boiling.
  5. Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the pure vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the hot cocoa into individual mugs and serve immediately, optionally topped with whipped cream, marshmallows, or chocolate shavings.

Tips

  • For an extra rich and decadent hot cocoa, add 1/4 cup (45 g) of chopped dark chocolate or chocolate chips to the mixture while it heats.
  • A pinch of ground cinnamon or a dash of peppermint extract can be added with the vanilla for a festive flavor variation.
  • To make a dairy-free version, substitute whole milk with your favorite plant-based milk, such as almond, oat, or soy milk.
